resources.string: Blockfy uses Accessibility only to detect Reels and Shorts in Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook and X, then take you back to the regular feed. It does not read other apps.

Blockfy uses Accessibility to notice when you open Reels or Shorts and to return you to the feed. It does not store your activity, and it does not control apps other than leaving short-video screens.
After Accessibility settings open, tap Blockfy under Downloaded apps, then turn the service on.
On some phones you must first allow restricted settings from the Blockfy app info screen.
Choose the language used in Blockfy. The default is English.
Blockfy stays free. A Pix contribution helps keep it that way.
Blockfy is free and open source. If it helps you stay off short videos, you can support development with Pix.

Blockfy helps you leave Reels, Shorts and similar feeds, with optional daily limits and an on-device adult-site DNS filter.\n\nIt is a fork of Blokky by Robin Gebert, maintained by Samuel Bueno. The original idea — a small, honest short-video blocker — is still the core of the app.

Accessibility is limited to Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook and X so Blockfy can leave Reels and Shorts. It does not read banking apps.

The optional adult shield uses a local DNS VPN and never uploads your browsing history. Banking apps are excluded from that VPN.

Updates come from Google Play. Blockfy does not install APKs itself.

string-array.item: You do not have to throw the next hour away.
This impulse will pass. Leave the page.
Future-you does not want this tab open.
Stop now. Protect the rest of your day.
You are stronger than a cheap dopamine loop.
Close it. The rest of your life is still waiting.

string-array.name: mindfulness_reels_quotes
string-array.item: Did you open this on purpose, or on autopilot?
Thirty minutes of strangers, or thirty minutes of your own life?
The feed is endless. Your time is not.
This is not rest. It is a trance. You can leave.
The algorithm is built to hold you. Prove it cannot.
Would you be proud of this hour a year from now?
Do what you came to do, then get out.
Nobody built a life they wanted by scrolling.
Your attention is the most expensive thing in this room.
Close the reel. Stand up. Do the next real thing.
